# Example: select and play a Spotify playlist long enough for a plan from Simple Note
from appworld.common.finders import find_all_from_pages

# Assume tokens are available via env helpers
simple_token = get_simple_note_access_token()
spotify_token = get_spotify_access_token()

# Find the plan note
notes = find_all_from_pages(apis.simple_note.search_notes,
                            access_token=simple_token,
                            query="workout")
note = next(n for n in notes if "workout" in n.title.lower())
content = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note.note_id, access_token=simple_token).content

# Parse duration for today (simplified)
today = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time().strftime("%A")
for block in content.split("\n\n"):
    if today.lower() in block.lower():
        duration_mins = int(block.split("duration_mins:")[-1].strip())
        break

# Find a playlist that lasts at least duration_mins
playlists = find_all_from_pages(apis.spotify.show_playlist_library,
                                access_token=spotify_token)
for pl in playlists:
    total_secs = sum(apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid).duration for sid in pl.song_ids)
    if total_secs / 60 >= duration_mins:
        apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_token, playlist_id=pl.playlist_id)
        break
